item.title: Funny How Bureaucracy Disappears When Billionaires Need Something Built.
item.description:
PRIORITIES: DEMOCRACY MOVES AT THE SPEED OF MONEY. Want high-speed rail? Fantastic. Here's 23 years of environmental reviews, public consultations, feasibility studies, political obstruction, and absolutely fuck-all to show for it.
Want a massive data centre? Suddenly everyone's discovered the express lane. Apparently, bureaucracy is an immovable object until corporate capital needs something built. Then it's merely a minor inconvenience. And here's the beautiful little trick: we're told public infrastructure is too expensive, too complicated, and too disruptive. Meanwhile, private infrastructure gets political urgency, tax incentives, enormous electricity demands, and communities left negotiating the consequences. Funny how the free market keeps needing public assistance. This isn't an argument against technology or environmental protections. It's an argument against a political economy where public benefit must justify every penny while private profit is treated as its own justification. The question was never whether society has the resources to build a better future. It's who gets to decide what that future looks like — and who gets stuck paying for it. Nothing to see here, folks. Just another spectacular triumph of capitalism. #PoliticalSatire #CorporateGreed #DataCenters #HighSpeedRail #PublicInfrastructure #EconomicInequality #CorporateWelfare #EnvironmentalJustice #Capitalism #DemotivationalPoster #Demotivator #SocialCommentary

item.title: It’s been 27 days since I almost died :-) trigger warning lol
item.description:
Hi friends. Starting this post off with a pic of some glam I did- since this has been my only means of artistic expression in the throes of my disease ruining my life!!! *~*~*TRIGGER WARNING, there is talk in this post of: medical emergency/blood loss, also mental illness/suicidal ideation*~*~* I GENUINELY CANNOT TAKE IT ANYMORE If you look at my previous posts there are a lot more details. To try to summarize: -I have a rare kind of vasculitis called EGPA -a couple months ago, my ENT (who I trust greatly. He has done both of my previous surgeries.) was looking at my sinuses with the endoscope, and he found something in my left ethmoid sinus, that “wasn’t a polyp” -I had a biopsy scheduled to see what it was -I started having insane nosebleeds -I lost half of my fcking blood, 911 had to be called, I needed a blood transfusion That leads me to now. It’s been almost a month since this happened and I am not doing good. Everything else aside- genuinely my mental health is barely holding on. I just don’t know man. Like, I have suffered with self harm and suicidal ideation GENUINELY since I was 11 years old. PTSD gang. I’m not cut out for this I barely had a will to live BEFORE this and my diagnosis. lol On top of that- this administration (I am in the US) doesn’t care if I live or die and I still remain uninsured. I am once again sharing my ko fi link… in hopes I might be able to get some help, because there are a lot of costs coming up relating to this. I’m supposed to get an MRI but genuinely I don’t see that happening! Like, they just don’t CARE. And, I know I’m asking strangers in the internet but… the care and consideration I’ve gotten from people in this community oftentimes surpasses that of even my family members. If anyone feels so inclined to check out my art and maybe help out, or even share something positive for me to read. I have a folder of my favorite Imgur comments and messages. It means more than you know… Help also goes to caring for my ratty boys… if I’m ever in a situation where it’s either me or them, I choose them, every time. Anyways… I’m rambling. If you read all of this. I love you. Thank you. I know times are shit for everyone. We gotta be there for each other. Kiss your pets for me. Ko fi: https://ko-fi.com/darkratlord/goal?g=64 Or my direct PyaPal: @sillygooseinc Enjoy the art if you check it out- I haven’t drawn in 14 months and I miss it. Thank you.

item.title: GovBrief Today #634
item.description: Social Security filled in the citizenship line on 25 million Americans’ records using a Homeland Security database that has flagged citizens as noncitizens. The agency called it the biggest cleanup in its 91-year history and said it is changing the citizenship status on 8.5 million more records. That database was rebuilt last year around Social Security’s own files, which the agency previously said can’t settle whether someone is a citizen. With the Supreme Court’s permission, DHS has spent the past month checking voters against those same Social Security records. On Monday, federal prosecutors brought a Homeland Security list to Washington state and asked it to set aside more than 400 ballots. Washington has recorded 15 noncitizen votes since 1982.
